_doc: Engine glue for the translated WaW in-game menus (wawmenu.py, waw_menu.lua). Each entry names the T4 engine state a menu reads or the engine menu it opens, and the T6 equivalent with its reason. Nothing here is a game rule.

options_new_pc.reason: WaW's options tree edits T4 engine settings (r_*, snd_*, bindings); T6 has its own renderer, sound and binding settings, so OPTIONS opens T6's settings menu.

dvars.zombiemode: 1: the converted level is a zombies map (T4 sets it before loading one).
dvars.mapname: the source WaW map name (menu_map_<map>, the HAS_INGAME_MAP test).
dvars.sv_running: T6 sv_running: this client hosts the level.
dvars.onlinegame: T6 session is neither offline nor system link.
dvars.xblive_privatematch: T6 GAMEMODE_PRIVATE_MATCH in an online session.
dvars.credits_active: empty: T6 has no credits level.

leave_commands._reason: Before a command that leaves or restarts the level, T6's popups (RestartGamePopup.Close, EndGamePopup.Close) clear the world blur, call LockInput(false) and SetUIActive(false), close every in-game menu and clear cl_paused; without that the restarted level keeps the cursor and takes no input. Restarts also run RestartGamePopup.RestartLevel's ui_busyBlockIngameMenu 1, stopControllerRumble, fade and silence.

menu_responses.reason: A T6 menu response reaches the server by a precached menu's index. WaW's popup names are not precached. endround goes out as T6's EndGamePopup.FinishEndGame sends it, under popup_leavegame after the leave above; other responses go under the host 'class' menu. BO2's _zm_gametype handler receives them (endround ends the game).
menu_responses.restart: fast_restart runs as T6's RestartGamePopup does: the command offline or in system link, otherwise the 'restart_level_zm' response under 'restartgamepopup'.
